title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced sub-national capacities for inclusive, climate-smart primary health care, focusing on zero-dose communities and children at risk of wasting and non-communicable diseases and injuries. Key achievements included upskilling health workers, supporting;first measles-rubella campaign since 2017, and promoting sustainable models for decentralized newborn care, solarization, and green waste management.
